power.answer: SWISS allows up to two power banks per passenger in hand baggage only, each up to 100 Wh (2 g lithium). They may not be used or charged on board except for approved medical devices. A power bank of 100 to 160 Wh needs SWISS's approval, which you request through the contact form when you book.

sections.h: 🔋 What SWISS says about power banks
sections.p: From the SWISS page "Electronic devices and batteries" (Switzerland, English), read on 23 November 2026.

list: Same rule across the group: SWISS belongs to the Lufthansa Group, which applies these rules from 15 January 2026.

faq: How do I get approval for a larger power bank on SWISS?
Use the contact form on the SWISS electronic devices page when you book, for power banks between 100 and 160 Wh.
Can I charge my phone from a power bank on SWISS?
No. SWISS prohibits charging and using power banks on board, except for approved medical devices.
